projectDescription: A deep NFL franchise simulation game featuring a dynamic Persona Engine, real-time contract negotiations, adaptive AI defense, and immersive broadcast presentation.
keyFeatures: Persona DNA Matrix with 65+ traits driving dynamic player decision-making
Interactive contract negotiation with live Interest & Patience meters
4-stage holdout and trade demand progression system
12-hour free agency bidding clock with AI front office competition
Right-stick precision tackle system with directional flick controls
Timed catching window mechanics replacing auto-catch
Smart Zone AI with play-call repetition penalties
Dynamic evolving weather engine affecting ball and surface physics
SuperSim engine with individual positional matchup weighting
MUT Evolution System with objective-based card upgrades
Superstar positional skill trees with on/off-field persona choices
Broadcast presentation with dynamic halftime shows and career milestone commentary
publicApiSurface: Decision Value Formula: w1(AAV) + w2(Guaranteed%) + w3(MarketSize) + w4(SnapShare) + w5(ChampionshipContenderIndex)
Holdout Stages: Locker Room Rumor → Social Media Post → Pre-Season Holdout → Formal Trade Request
Contract Dialogue Engine: Offer Structure, Interest Meter, Patience Meter, Dynamic Actions
AI Adaptability Adjustment: Base Awareness × (Concept Calls × 0.15)
Weather Physics Chain: Dry Turf → Light Rain (+10% fumble) → Mud/Slippery (-20% cut traction)
UDFA Signing Period & 90-man roster cutoff phase
Franchise Tag types: Exclusive, Non-Exclusive, Transition
Superstar skill trees: Media Presence vs. Film Room Preparation
